race.comment: HOT WINGS (7) raced handy then worked home well but found one better when resuming over this distance at Casino last start. Up in grade today but strips fitter and Andrew Mallyon is back aboard - he has won twice from three rides on the mare. CUSTO (6) has been about the mark without threatening since a win here on 21 September. Battled on evenly and was beaten under two lengths over 1100m at Ipswich last Saturday. Has a decent 1000m record so this looks a nice race for him. AMAYA'S SECRET (4) dug deep to just get the prize at her latest appearance over today's journey at Ballina. Distance specialist who can run another big race with the help of the inside gate. COME ON GLAMOUR (5) is back after a 24-week spell. Only raced once last prep and finished a close third in a similar race to this at Taree. Honest mare who has three wins at the trip from six attempts. DAMAS (1) drops in grade on his four runs so far this prep. One to keep very safe with blinkers on for the first time.
